# Collision rules

The international collision regulations decide which vessel gives way. A sailing boat on port tack gives way to one on starboard tack, and the windward boat keeps clear of the leeward one. Lights at night are covered in [[Night passage]].

## Power and sail

A powered vessel gives way to a sailing vessel, except a large ship that is restricted to a channel; there, keep clear of it.

## Overtaking

The overtaking vessel always keeps clear, whatever its type, until it is well past and clear.
